workflow_rationale: Extending an existing RTL system (email) to new deliverable types (presentations, social media, documents, web). This is a multi-stage feature expansion that adds RTL-aware templates, validation rules, and localization instructions across the brand system.

phases.name: RTL Documentation for Each Deliverable Type
phases.description: Create comprehensive RTL layout guidelines for presentations, social media, documents, and web templates by adapting email RTL patterns

subtasks.description: Create presentations RTL layout guide based on email RTL patterns

verification.instructions: Review presentation-transitions.md to confirm it includes: (1) RTL slide layout rules, (2) text direction for Arabic titles/body, (3) chevron positioning in RTL, (4) layer naming for RTL Smart Animate transitions

subtasks.notes: Add section 'RTL Layout Rules for Arabic Decks' covering: dir attributes, text alignment, chevron handling, and Smart Animate layer naming for RTL transitions

subtasks.description: Create social media RTL layout guide

verification.instructions: Review social-media-rtl.md to confirm it includes: (1) text placement rules for RTL, (2) image/text alignment, (3) platform-specific RTL considerations (Instagram, LinkedIn, Twitter), (4) example layouts

subtasks.notes: Document RTL layout for social media graphics: text-right alignment, image placement (left side in RTL), logo positioning, CTA button placement

subtasks.description: Add RTL section to PDF forms documentation

verification.instructions: Review pdf-forms.md to confirm new RTL section includes: (1) right-to-left field ordering, (2) label alignment (right-aligned), (3) table direction, (4) header alignment, (5) Arabic text in form fields

subtasks.notes: Added section 'Arabic RTL rules (non-negotiable)' covering: field ordering, label alignment, table direction, header alignment, Arabic text rendering in form fields, directionality in pdf-lib stamping, and validation checkpoints

subtasks.description: Add RTL section to design system for web templates

verification.instructions: Review design-system.md to confirm RTL section includes: (1) CSS dir attribute usage, (2) flexbox/grid direction, (3) margin/padding mirroring, (4) chevron positioning in RTL layouts

subtasks.notes: Added comprehensive section 6 'RTL (Right-to-Left) Implementation' with 11 subsections covering: dir attribute, CSS logical properties, flexbox/grid direction, margin/padding mirroring, chevron positioning with bidi isolation, Latin/numeric wrapping, text alignment, Tailwind CSS support, kashida rules, testing checklist, and common mistakes. Renumbered sections 6-9 to 7-10.

subtasks.description: Create master RTL layout guide with cross-format rules

verification.instructions: Review rtl-layout-guide.md to confirm it includes: (1) universal RTL principles, (2) format-specific sections, (3) code examples, (4) common gotchas, (5) QA checklist

subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive master RTL guide (938 lines) covering: (A) Universal RTL Principles, (B) Format-Specific RTL Patterns for email/social/web/PDF/presentations, (C) Code Examples, (D) Common Gotchas, (E) Platform-Specific Rendering Quirks, (F) RTL QA Checklist, (G) Migration Notes, (H) Resources & Tooling, (I) Changelog. Cross-references all format-specific guides.

phases.name: Extend Localization Prompt with RTL Instructions
phases.description: Update the English-to-Arabic localization prompt to include format-specific RTL layout instructions for each deliverable type

subtasks.description: Add RTL layout instructions to localization prompt Section 5

verification.instructions: Review content-prompts.md Section 5 to confirm additions include: (1) Content Type field now includes Email/Presentation/Social/Document/Web, (2) Format-specific RTL instructions subsection, (3) Examples for each format

subtasks.notes: Extended Section 5 with Content Type field (Email/Presentation/Social/Document/Web) and comprehensive format-specific RTL instructions with examples for each format, following patterns from rtl-layout-guide.md and email-design-system.md

phases.name: Add RTL Design Tokens
phases.description: Extend design tokens with RTL-specific spacing and layout direction values

subtasks.description: Add RTL spacing and direction tokens to azmx-tokens.json
subtasks.notes: Added comprehensive RTL token section with 42 tokens including: direction values (ltr/rtl), text alignment (start/end/center), logical spacing tokens (inline-start/end, block-start/end), RTL-aware margins/padding/borders/insets, border radius logical properties, transform utilities for RTL (flip-x, rotate-icon), and directional glyphs (chevrons, arrows, quotes). Tokens support both LTR and RTL modes.

phases.name: Extend Validation with RTL Rules
phases.description: Add RTL layout validation rules to brand-check.py script

subtasks.description: Add RTL validation rules to brand-check.py

verification.expected: RTL validation rules mentioned in help text

subtasks.notes: Implemented RTL validation checks: (1) Missing dir='rtl' on <table>/<td> tags in Arabic context (blocker), (2) Chevrons not wrapped in dir='ltr' spans (blocker), (3) letter-spacing on Arabic text (major). Updated docstring to document RTL rules. Tested with sample HTML containing RTL violations - all checks working correctly.

subtasks.description: Create test fixtures for RTL validation
subtasks.notes: Created two HTML test fixtures: test-rtl-valid.html demonstrates correct RTL patterns (passes with 0 blockers), test-rtl-invalid.html contains intentional violations (5 blocker RTL violations for missing dir attributes and unwrapped chevrons, 1 major violation for letter-spacing on Arabic text)

phases.name: Integration Verification
phases.description: Verify all RTL documentation, prompts, tokens, and validation work together across all deliverable types

steps: Verify rtl-layout-guide.md covers all 4 formats (presentations, social, documents, web)
Verify content-prompts.md Section 5 references format-specific RTL rules
Run brand-check.py on RTL test fixtures and confirm it catches violations
Cross-reference email-design-system.md RTL rules with new guides for consistency

subtasks.notes: All 5 verification steps passed: (1) rtl-layout-guide.md covers 5 formats (email, presentations, social, documents, web), (2) content-prompts.md Section 5 includes format-specific RTL instructions with examples, (3) azmx-tokens.json contains 42 RTL tokens, (4) brand-check.py successfully validates RTL rules (test-rtl-valid.html: 0 blockers, test-rtl-invalid.html: 5 blockers + 1 major), (5) email-design-system.md and rtl-layout-guide.md are consistent with proper cross-references. All acceptance criteria met.

parallel_groups.reason: Both depend only on phase-1-documentation and modify different file sets

parallelism.speedup_estimate: Sequential execution recommended due to documentation dependencies

summary.startup_command: No services to start - documentation and validation only

acceptance_criteria: RTL layout guides exist for presentations, social media, documents, and web
Each guide covers text direction, alignment, margin/padding mirroring, numeral formatting
Localization prompt updated with format-specific RTL instructions

verification_steps.name: Validation Script Test
verification_steps.expected_outcome: No RTL violations detected in valid fixture

verification_strategy.reasoning: Low risk documentation-focused changes. Manual review sufficient for guidelines, command-line validation for brand-check.py extensions.

checks: RTL guides exist for all 4 deliverable types
brand-check.py help text mentions RTL validation
